original:
योग एष मया प्रोक्तो नृणां श्रेयोविधित्सया ।
ज्ञानवैराग्यसहिते भक्तावेव परं पदम् ॥
sanskrit:
योग एष मया प्रोक्तो नृणां श्रेयोविधित्सया ।
ज्ञानवैराग्यसहिते भक्तावेव परं पदम् ॥
transliteration:
yoga eṣa mayā prokto nṛṇāṃ śreyovidhitsayā |
jñānavairāgyasahite bhaktāv eva paraṃ padam ||
translation: Lord Kapila said: This yoga system of devotion, accompanied by knowledge and renunciation, has been expounded by Me for the ultimate benefit of humanity.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: भगवान कपिल ने कहा: मनुष्यों के परम कल्याण की इच्छा से मैंने ज्ञान और वैराग्य से युक्त इस भक्तियोग का उपदेश दिया है।

layers.author: sant_eknath
layers.content: भगवान कपिलांनी सांगितले: मानवाच्या परम कल्याणासाठी मी ज्ञान आणि वैराग्याने युक्त अशा भक्तियोगाचा उपदेश केला आहे.

layers.author: sridhara_swami
layers.content: Kapila's teachings to Mother Devahuti in Canto 3 synthesize Sankhya metaphysics with the highest devotion.

layers.author: prabhupada
layers.content: Bhakti-yoga includes all knowledge and renunciation automatically without needing dry speculative effort.
